gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Eater brings a dark, snarling look, with thin strokes that never turn to hairlines and gaps stretched between the letters. Noto Sans Phoenician is the modern foil, a plain sans with generous lowercase height.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Flavors has a towering x-height like a stubby carpenter's pencil, and its diagonals carry as much heft as the stems. Noto Sans Rejang answers with wide porthole counters.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri reads as a plain sans with unclosed, open curves. Almendra Display is the ornate, literary one with a pronounced x-height, while the body font keeps the lines of text tall and plain.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Audiowide looks like bent tubing, one gauge from end to end, with glyphs spaced like tiles and wide grout lines. Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curve endings keeping well apart.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-runic: Eater is dark and aggressive, with short ascenders and wide gaps between its letters, and only a soft change in thickness along the curves. Noto Sans Runic sits beside it, big in the x-height and modern.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan is an approachable sans with plenty of daylight inside its curves and a hefty lowercase body. Flavors earns its keep big and short, a ribbon of constant width forming every whimsical glyph.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tc: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans TC sits beside it, a friendly sans-serif with open counters.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Audiowide draws every stroke like a thick drawn wire, futuristic and tech, with tall lowercase set like tiles. Its strongest quality is that consistency, which Noto Sans Syloti Nagri matches with short ascenders.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada is the clean, professional one, with open c forms and bulky lowercase proportions. Eater earns its keep big and short, its curves thinning out modestly where they turn.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Chunky, bent-pipe letters with a towering x-height make Flavors feel whimsical and loud. And Noto Sans Siddham gives a longer passage an approachable feel, with a large central band and an s whose ends hang far from the spine.
